name: dev.workers.svenco.tidyquid/tidyquid
title: Tidy Quid budget planners
description: UK budget planner finder + free 50/30/20 pay check and UK tax-year dates. Read-only, no sign-in.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: List Tidy Quid digital budget planners and money trackers (Excel / Google Sheets / printable PDF) with price in GBP, country edition, language, what each does and the Etsy or Gumroad link. Filter by country (UK, US, DE, FR, AU, CA, PL), category, max price or free-text query.

country.description: UK, US, DE, FR, AU, CA or PL

tools.name: recommend_planner
tools.description: Pick the single best Tidy Quid planner for a person's country and need (e.g. 'Christmas', 'annual bills', 'self assessment', 'energy bills', 'wedding', 'Haushaltsbuch', 'budget familial'). Returns the match, why, cheaper or bundle alternatives and the store link.

country.description: UK, US, DE, FR, AU, CA or PL. Default UK.

need.description: What the person wants to sort out, in their words.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details for one Tidy Quid planner by product_id (from search_products or recommend_planner) or by name: price in GBP, formats, what it does, who it suits, every store link (Etsy and Gumroad), plus any bundle that includes it and other planners for the same country.

product_id.description: Product id, e.g. 'uk-budget-planner-2026-27', or the product name.

tools.name: check_uk_budget
tools.description: Free calculator for UK take-home pay: converts weekly, fortnightly or 4-weekly pay to an average month, splits it 50/30/20, sets aside yearly bills monthly, says how much of pay goes on essentials, and suggests the matching Tidy Quid planner plus the free Budget Starter. Arithmetic only, not advice. Stores nothing.

take_home_pay.description: Pay after tax, NI and pension, in GBP, per pay period

monthly_bills.description: Monthly essentials: rent/mortgage, council tax, energy, food, transport, debts (GBP)

annual_bills.description: Total of once-a-year bills (MOT, car tax, insurance, TV Licence, Christmas) in GBP

goal.description: Optional, e.g. 'Christmas', 'save for a wedding', 'energy bills'

tools.name: get_uk_money_dates
tools.description: Key UK personal-finance dates for the 2026/27 tax year: tax year start and end, Self Assessment deadlines (31 January 2027), payments on account, ISA allowance and Making Tax Digital thresholds, each with GOV.UK sources.

tools.name: request_product
tools.description: Tell Tidy Quid about a budgeting/money planner your user wanted that we don't have, or what would make our tools more useful. Short need description, optional country and format.

need.description: Short description of the planner or improvement that was wanted. Do not send names, emails or account details.

country.description: UK, US, DE, FR, AU, CA or PL, if known.

format.description: Preferred format, e.g. Excel, Google Sheets, printable PDF.
